videos.title: Fable 5.2: 18 Wild Things You Can Build
videos.ai_tech_id: Anthropic's Claude, specifically the newly released Fable 5.2 model (with a comparison to Opus 5.5), showcased through 18 community and creator-built examples spanning games, animation, video editing, and hardware design
summary: Paul Lipsky curated 18 examples built with Claude's Fable 5.2 model, spanning playable games, animations, video editing tools, and even hardware design projects, several of which are his own creations.

He highlights what impressed him most about Fable 5.2's capabilities while also being candid about where the model still falls short, giving viewers a balanced read on the model's current strengths and limitations.

Despite the new release, Lipsky notes he still uses Claude's Opus 5.5 for many everyday tasks, and the video links out to the original creators, including Felix Rieseberg's first-person shooter and Kevin's multi-world boat ride, so viewers can explore the source projects themselves.

videos.title: One scene, 86 animation styles, all made by Claude
videos.ai_tech_id: Anthropic's Claude, used to generate 86 different animation styles for the same scene entirely through code it wrote, with no separate video-generation model involved
summary: Futurepedia showcases a single robot scene rendered in 86 different animation styles, with every frame generated entirely as code written by Claude rather than through a traditional video generation model.

The video samples 13 of those styles to demonstrate the visual range Claude can produce from one underlying scene description, illustrating how a code-first approach to animation can yield highly varied artistic results.
Viewers interested in reproducing the effects are pointed to a related video containing all 86 styles along with copy-paste prompts, making this a practical showcase rather than just a demo reel.
